## 2. Color System

All tokens are defined as CSS custom properties in `App.css` under `:root, .dark {}`.
**Rule: Never use raw hex values in JSX className strings or component props.** Use CSS vars or Tailwind `var(--token)` references only. Recharts `contentStyle` objects are the only pragmatic exception.

### 2.1 Background & Surface

| Token               | Value              | Use |
|---------------------|--------------------|-----|
| `--background`      | `#070c18`          | App root, page background |
| `--card`            | `#0c1424`          | Card surfaces, panels |
| `--sv-surface-2`    | `#101c30`          | Elevated within card, input bg |
| `--sv-surface-3`    | `#152038`          | Hover states, adv-inner bg |
| `--popover`         | `#0c1424`          | Dropdown, tooltip bg |

### 2.2 Brand & Primary

| Token               | Value              | Use |
|---------------------|--------------------|-----|
| `--primary`         | `#7C5CFF`          | Primary CTA buttons |
| `--sv-accent`       | `#7C5CFF`          | Violet — AI, intelligence |
| `--sv-accent-hi`    | `#9B7FFF`          | Hover violet |
| `--sv-accent-lo`    | `#5B3FE8`          | Active/pressed violet |
| `--sv-accent-dim`   | `rgba(124,92,255,0.14)` | Violet tinted bg |
| `--sv-accent-glow`  | `rgba(124,92,255,0.28)` | Button shadow |

### 2.3 Security Semantic Colors

These carry UX meaning. **Never use these decoratively.** Always pair color with an icon or text label.

| State         | Token            | Value            | Icon Pair |
|---------------|------------------|------------------|-----------|
| Secure / OK   | `--sv-green`     | `#00d97e`        | `CheckCircle2` |
| Warning       | amber            | `#f59e0b`        | `AlertTriangle` |
| Threat / Error| `--sv-red`       | `#ff4466`        | `AlertCircle` |
| AI / Analysis | `--sv-accent`    | `#7C5CFF`        | `ScanSearch`, `Sparkles` |
| Info          | sky              | `#38bdf8`        | `Info` |

### 2.4 Text

| Token                  | Value         | Use |
|------------------------|---------------|-----|
| `--foreground`         | `#edf2fa`     | Primary text — all headings, body |
| `--muted-foreground`   | `#7a8fa6`     | Secondary text, labels, captions |
| `--sv-text-3`          | `#3d5066`     | Tertiary — hints, disabled |

**Contrast requirement:** Primary text on `--card` = `#edf2fa` on `#0c1424` ≈ 14:1 ✓ (AAA). Muted text ≈ 5.2:1 ✓ (AA).

### 2.5 Border & Input

| Token    | Value                     | Use |
|----------|---------------------------|-----|
| `--border` | `rgba(255,255,255,0.08)` | Card borders, separators |
| `--input`  | `rgba(255,255,255,0.07)` | Input field background |
| `--ring`   | `rgba(124,92,255,0.45)`  | Focus ring |

## 3. Typography System

**Font stack:** `'Geist Variable', 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif`
**Mono font:** `'JetBrains Mono', 'Fira Code', 'Courier New', monospace` — hashes, code output, decoded secrets

### 3.1 Type Scale (strict)

| Role          | Size  | Weight | Line-height | Tailwind |
|---------------|-------|--------|-------------|---------|
| Display / Stat| 28px  | 800    | 1.0         | `text-3xl font-extrabold` |
| Title         | 20px  | 700    | 1.2         | `text-xl font-bold` |
| Section Head  | 16px  | 600    | 1.3         | `text-base font-semibold` |
| Card Title    | 14px  | 700    | 1.3         | `text-sm font-bold` |
| Body          | 14px  | 400    | 1.5         | `text-sm` |
| Body Small    | 13px  | 400    | 1.5         | `text-[13px]` |
| Label / Cap   | 11px  | 600    | 1.2         | `text-[11px] font-semibold` |
| Label Cap Micro| 10px | 700    | 1.0         | `text-[10px] font-bold` |
| Floor         | 10px  | any    | —           | **Never go below 10px** |

**Rules:**
- Body text in inputs, textareas, table cells: `text-[13px]` minimum
- No `text-[9px]` anywhere — **this is an anti-pattern**
- Numbers in stat cards use `tabular-nums tracking-tight`
- Decoded secrets and hashes use `font-mono text-[12px]`

### 3.2 Font Weight Hierarchy

| Level      | Weight | Class |
|------------|--------|-------|
| Display    | 800    | `font-extrabold` |
| Heading    | 700    | `font-bold` |
| Subheading | 600    | `font-semibold` |
| Label      | 500–600| `font-medium` / `font-semibold` |
| Body       | 400    | `font-normal` |

## 4. Spacing System

**Base:** 4px grid. All spacing values must be multiples of 4.

| Scale | px | Tailwind | Use |
|-------|----|----------|-----|
| 1     | 4  | `p-1`    | Icon padding, tight gaps |
| 2     | 8  | `p-2`    | Tag spacing, compact rows |
| 3     | 12 | `p-3`    | Card inner tight |
| 4     | 16 | `p-4`    | Card default padding |
| 5     | 20 | `p-5`    | Card generous padding |
| 6     | 24 | `p-6`    | Section gap |
| 8     | 32 | `p-8`    | Between major sections |
| 12    | 48 | `p-12`   | Page-level vertical rhythm |

**Component gap defaults:**
- Form field groups: `gap-4` (16px)
- Within a field (label → input): `gap-1.5` (6px)
- Cards within a grid: `gap-3` (12px)
- Stat cards row: `gap-3` (12px)

---

## 5. Component Rules

### 5.1 Buttons

| Rule | Spec |
|------|------|
| Primary CTA | `bg-violet-600 hover:bg-violet-500`, min `h-10` (40px) |
| Touch target | Minimum `h-10 px-5` = 40×80px minimum |
| Only one primary per view | Every view has exactly ONE violet button |
| Secondary | `variant="ghost"` or `variant="outline"` |
| Danger | `variant="destructive"` — only for delete/destructive actions |
| Loading state | `disabled` + `aria-busy={true}` + spinner icon + "…" suffix |
| Icon buttons | Must have `aria-label` — no silent icon-only buttons |
| Disabled opacity | `disabled:opacity-40` |

### 5.2 Inputs & Forms

| Rule | Spec |
|------|------|
| Height | Minimum `h-10` (40px) — never `h-9` or below |
| Font size | `text-[13px]` |
| Required indicator | `<span aria-hidden="true" className="text-destructive ml-0.5">*</span>` after label text |
| Label connection | `<Label htmlFor="input-id">` + `<Input id="input-id">` |
| Password fields | Must have show/hide toggle (`Eye`/`EyeOff` Lucide icons) |
| Error placement | Below the specific field — never only at top of form |
| Error content | Must name the field AND the fix: "Master password is required." not "Field required." |
| Helper text | `text-[11px] text-muted-foreground/60` below input |
| Placeholder | Supplemental only — never the sole label |
| Autofill | Add `autoComplete` attributes to all password/email inputs |

### 5.3 Cards

| Rule | Spec |
|------|------|
| Background | `--card: #0c1424` via shadcn Card (do not override inline) |
| Border | `border-border/50` (shadcn default, no custom border-color on card) |
| Border radius | 8px (shadcn default `--radius`) |
| Elevation accent | Violet top-line: `<div className="h-px bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-violet-500/70 to-transparent" />` — on PRIMARY card per view only |
| Shadow | Only on primary/modal cards: `shadow-[0_0_0_1px_rgba(124,92,255,0.08)]` |
| No random shadows | Use the defined shadow scale, not ad-hoc `shadow-*` values |

### 5.4 Badges

| Rule | Spec |
|------|------|
| Use for | Status, encryption type, AI tags — never purely decorative |
| Shape | `rounded-full` for status tags, `rounded-md` for category tags |
| Sizes | `text-[10px]` micro, `text-[11px]` standard |
| Semantic colors only | success=emerald, warning=amber, error=red, info=violet |
| Color alone | Always pair color with text — no color-only status badges |

### 5.5 Tables

| Rule | Spec |
|------|------|
| Header text | `text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest` |
| Body text | `text-[12px]` minimum |
| Monospace | Hash/code columns use `font-mono` |
| Sort state | `aria-sort` on sortable `<th>` |
| Row actions | Icon buttons must have `aria-label` |
| Empty state | When no data: show message + action, never just empty rows |

### 5.6 Dropzones

| Rule | Spec |
|------|------|
| Default | Dashed border, centered icon + label + hint |
| Drag active | Violet border + violet-tinted bg |
| File selected | Emerald border + emerald-tinted bg + file info |
| Accessible | Wrapper is `role="button"` with keyboard support |
| Hidden input | `<input type="file">` hidden, triggered by wrapper click/keydown |

## 7. Animation Rules

| Rule | Value | Notes |
|------|-------|-------|
| Micro-interaction | 150–200ms | Hover, focus, press feedback |
| Transition | 200–300ms | State changes (open/close, active) |
| Complex | 300–400ms | Tab transitions, panel open |
| Never | > 500ms | Feels sluggish |
| Easing in | `ease-out` | Entering elements |
| Easing out | `ease-in` | Exiting elements |
| Properties | `transform`, `opacity` ONLY | Never animate `width`, `height`, `top`, `left` |
| Exit faster | 60–70% of enter duration | Exits feel responsive |
| Reduced motion | `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` | All durations → 0.01ms |

**Tab transition:** `translateY(5px) → translateY(0)` + `opacity: 0 → 1`, `160ms ease-out`
**Score bars:** `scaleX(0 → 1)` from left origin, `500ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)`
**Buttons:** `transform scale-[0.98]` on active (use Tailwind `active:scale-[0.98]`)
**Skeleton shimmer:** 1.6s ease-in-out infinite — respect reduced-motion

## 8. Form Patterns

### 8.1 Field Template

```jsx
<div className="space-y-1.5">
  <Label htmlFor={id} className="field-label">
    {icon} {label}
    {required && <span aria-hidden="true" className="text-destructive ml-0.5">*</span>}
  </Label>
  <Input id={id} ... />
  {helperText && <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground/60">{helperText}</p>}
</div>
```

### 8.2 Password Field Template

```jsx
<div className="relative">
  <Input id={id} type={show ? 'text' : 'password'} ... className="pr-10" />
  <button type="button" aria-label={show ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password'}
    onClick={() => setShow(s => !s)}
    className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground/60 hover:text-muted-foreground transition-colors">
    {show ? <EyeOff size={14} /> : <Eye size={14} />}
  </button>
</div>
```

### 8.3 Validation Rules

- Validate on submit, not on every keystroke
- Validate each field individually, report the FIRST missing field
- Error message format: `"[Field name] is required."` or `"[Field name] must be [constraint]."`
- On success: clear the alert after 5 seconds, or on next user action

## 9. Chart & Data Visualization

| Rule | Spec |
|------|------|
| Chart wrapper | `<figure aria-label="[Chart title]: [one-sentence insight]">` |
| Legend | Always visible, positioned above or beside chart |
| Gridlines | `stroke="#1e2d45"` (low-contrast, non-competing) |
| Tooltip | Always on hover/tap; `contentStyle` uses navy bg, border |
| Color pairs | Violet `#7C5CFF` + Emerald `#10b981` — colorblind-safe divergent pair |
| Axis labels | `fill: '#64748b', fontSize: 11` — readable, not cramped |
| Donut center | Text label + sub-label for the primary metric |
| Responsive | `<ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={N}>` always |
| Empty state | "No data yet" message with guidance — never blank axis |

---

## 10. Security-Specific UX Patterns

### 10.1 Encryption Status

Always show encryption algorithm as a badge near the action — user must know what protects their data.

```jsx
<span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground/60">Encrypted with AES-256-GCM</span>
```

### 10.2 Irreversible Actions

Any action that cannot be undone (delete secret, overwrite image) **must**:
1. Use `variant="destructive"` button (red)
2. Show a confirmation dialog before executing
3. Explain what will be lost

### 10.3 Password Fields

- Always offer show/hide toggle
- Never auto-fill on decode (the user must consciously type the key)
- Add `autoComplete="new-password"` on encode, `autoComplete="current-password"` on decode

### 10.4 Score / Risk Indicators

Always pair score color with text rating:
- 80–100: emerald + "Excellent" 
- 65–79: violet + "Good"
- 45–64: amber + "Fair"
- 0–44: red + "Poor"

Never communicate risk by color alone.

---

## 11. Anti-Patterns (DO NOT DO)

| Anti-pattern | Why | Fix |
|--------------|-----|-----|
| `text-[9px]` anywhere | Below readable floor | Use `text-[10px]` minimum |
| Raw hex in JSX `className` | Breaks token system | Use Tailwind classes or CSS vars |
| Multiple primary CTAs per view | Dilutes user focus | One violet button per view max |
| `h-9` inputs (36px) | Below 44px touch target | Use `h-10` minimum (40px) |
| Password field without show/hide | Poor UX for security tool | Add EyeOff toggle |
| Color-only status | Inaccessible | Always add icon + text |
| Decorative glassmorphism | Noise over signal | Blur only on elevated/modal surfaces |
| Animation on `width`/`height` | Triggers layout reflow | Use `transform: scaleX()` |
| Missing `aria-label` on icon buttons | Screen reader inaccessible | Always add `aria-label` |
| Mixng `text-[13px]` and `text-sm` | Inconsistent scale | Pick one and stick with it |
| `onCheckedChange` + parent `onClick` both toggling state | Double-fire bug | Make Switch `pointer-events-none` when inside a button |
| Generic error messages | User can't recover | Name the specific field |
| Missing `htmlFor`/`id` link | Form labels don't associate | Always pair Label htmlFor + Input id |

## 12. Pre-Delivery Checklist

Run through this before any UI PR:

### Accessibility
- [ ] All icon-only interactive elements have `aria-label`
- [ ] All form inputs have `<Label htmlFor="...">` connected via `id`
- [ ] Required fields are marked with `*` and `aria-required="true"`  
- [ ] Chart `<figure>` elements have `aria-label` with key insight
- [ ] Loading buttons have `aria-busy={true}`
- [ ] Error states use `role="alert"` or `aria-live="polite"`
- [ ] No `text-[9px]` anywhere

### Interaction
- [ ] All password inputs have show/hide toggle
- [ ] Form validation error names the specific field
- [ ] All async buttons are disabled + show spinner during loading
- [ ] Destructive actions have confirmation step

### Visual
- [ ] No more than one violet (primary) CTA per view
- [ ] All stat numbers use `tabular-nums`
- [ ] No raw hex in JSX (only Tailwind utilities or CSS vars)
- [ ] Icon style is Lucide throughout (consistent stroke)
- [ ] No decorative blur on non-elevated surfaces

### Performance  
- [ ] `prefers-reduced-motion` applied globally
- [ ] Tab transitions use `transform` + `opacity` only
- [ ] No animations on `width`/`height` properties

### Forms
- [ ] `autoComplete` attribute on all password inputs
- [ ] Error message format: "[Field] is required." / "[Field] must be..."
- [ ] Helper text present on complex fields (password strength hints, etc.)
